name: Roger Marshall
bio: Roger Wayne Marshall is an American politician, physician, and former military officer serving as the junior United States senator from Kansas since 2021. From 2017 to 2021, he was the U.S. representative for Kansas's 1st congressional district, a mostly rural district covering much of western and northern Kansas. Marshall is a member of the Republican Party.

comments.billTitle: Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act
comments.text: Just 2 years ago, we were a land of open borders, crime was surging across the country, and fraud was rampant. But today, the borders are secure; crime,  murder rates--a 100-year low; and fraudsters are going to jail. That is why today I am rising to support the Protecting American Taxpayers Act. For years, Washington accepted fraud as the cost of doing business. The government wrote the checks, the fraudsters cashed them, and hard- working Americans were left to foot the bill.
